en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Giyas Bin Ibrahim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> used to lengthen the sole of his<sup>asws</sup> sandal’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
My father would keep Dhawa’ib (the clump) of his shoes longer.’”
